title: US dollar to Singapore dollar, daily since 1981
description: Singapore dollars per US dollar and US dollars per Singapore dollar since 1981: MAS's noon rate (daily from 2003, weekly from 1988) and, from 1981 to 1987, the US Federal Reserve's H.10 noon buying rates.
question: How many Singapore dollars is one US dollar, on any day since 1981?

row.is: One working day (one week from 1988 to 2002)

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: sgd_per_usd
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per US dollar, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: usd_per_sgd
fields.meaning: US dollars one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: MAS = MAS, as of noon; Federal Reserve H.10 = the US Federal Reserve's H.10 noon buying rates (1981 to 1987).
